title: Scholarly Profile Auditor: bibliographic audit with SNII Cita A/B classification
description:
Local-first software for reproducible bibliographic auditing of researcher profiles. Integrates ORCID, OpenAlex, Crossref, DataCite, arXiv and Semantic Scholar through a guided three-step workflow:

  1. Author identification — accepts ORCID, Google Scholar URL, or full name (with multi-source candidate search and human-in-the-loop confirmation).
  2. Publication confirmation — exhaustive search across certified databases with deduplication and per-source confidence score; the user marks which works are theirs.
  3. Citation analysis — classifies each citing paper as Cita A (strictly external, no author of the cited work appears in the citer) or Cita B (excludes only the evaluated researcher's self-citations), following the official criteria of Mexico's Sistema Nacional de Investigadoras e Investigadores (SNII), Area I (Physico-Mathematics and Earth Sciences).

Includes a standalone HTML widget that runs entirely in the browser (no backend required) and is embeddable in personal academic pages.

Important: the system never emits an automatic SNII level. It is a documentation tool; qualitative evaluation remains the committee's responsibility.
notes: This software does not emit automatic SNII level classifications. It applies the official Cita A and Cita B definitions from SECIHTI Area I criteria, computed from public APIs (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar). Self-citation logic uses author identity matching by ORCID and normalized name comparison (with Unicode LaTeX-apostrophe handling).
